summary: Regression tested the 2026-09-12 OpenRouter Token Bleed / Header Metadata / Guard Model Downgrade task. Created backend regression test suite (23 tests, all passing) covering: (1) call_openrouter_model builds X-Title='AUREM - <feature>' with hardcoded HTTP-Referer=https://auremcto.com; (2) ora_chat.providers._headers() correctly falls back to 'AUREM - ORA Chat' and honors feature kwarg; (3) mermaid_diagram/vision_describe/advisor_vision X-Title strings match required values with hardcoded auremcto.com Referer; (4) provider fanout (_call_claude/_call_glm/_call_longcat/_call_deepseek) and call_llm_with_meta accept 'feature' kwarg; (5) agents.py role features (Reader/Coder/Reviewer/Security Agent) wired; loop_engine passes feature='Loop Planning'; loop_verify passes feature='Self-Heal Retry'; (6) budget-gate call sites (assert_has_budget / assert_has_task_budget) still present in chat/stream, chat/turn, diagram, upload, cto_projects/tasks; (7) live smoke tests against preview URL — /api/aurem-dev/chat/stream returned real OpenRouter/DeepSeek response with proper SSE tokens; /api/aurem-dev/diagram/generate returned valid mermaid_code. Backend booted cleanly, all crons (hallucination_cron every 4h, ORA grounding canary daily 02:30 UTC, daily persona-eval, preview-sandbox sweeper 5min) armed with no import errors. Frontend home loads cleanly.
critical_code_review_comments: Header/feature wiring is consistent across all 4 feature-tagged services (mermaid, vision_describe, advisor_vision, ora_chat providers) and the generic client (openrouter_client.call_openrouter_model). No hardcoded/stale 'Aurem' (lowercase e) or 'Graph Diagram' titles remain — verified via grep.

openrouter_client._OPENROUTER_REFERER is a module-level constant; ora_chat/providers.py, mermaid, vision, advisor each independently hardcode 'https://auremcto.com' as literals. Consider consolidating to a single shared constant in a future cleanup to prevent future drift if the branding domain ever changes (minor / non-blocking).

Task said 'downgrade non-user-facing callers to cheap model if expensive'. Investigation-note confirms all identified periodic callers (hallucination classifier, grounding canary, persona-eval) already used cheap tier — verified in code (hallucination_classifier uses DeepSeek V3, canary uses default 'swift' review_mode). No model downgrade was applied and none needed.

Free-tier budget-gate regression: live call with free-gate-test-0822@aurem.dev account still allowed a chat/stream request even when 'tokens_remaining: 0' surfaced in the done frame. This is likely because assert_has_budget checks pre-call state (is_exhausted flag) and tokens are decremented post-call — so the FIRST call after balance is 'about to hit zero' passes through and only subsequent calls get blocked. This matches PRE-EXISTING behavior (not touched this session). No regression.
